title: Quadratic circuit equation system
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates, and use $1+n+g$ variables over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The associated system, in order, consists of the constant equation, one gate equation for each gate in the circuit's order, and the output equation.
